text:
Type: round extendable pedestal dining table
Use: dining, hosting guests; dining room, kitchen
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: black stained and painted solid wood, turned wooden pedestal
Colors: black, dark black-brown
Shape: round top with a molded edge that extends to an oval, thick turned baluster pedestal on four curved splayed feet, medium visual weight
Feel: elegant, cozy, timeless, sturdy
Goes with: white or black spindle chairs, light walls, warm wood floors; classic or farmhouse dining rooms and kitchens
